<!-- hermes-sweeper:item=24840 -->
<!-- hermes-sweeper:verdict=close reason=implemented_on_main confidence=high -->
This is an automated hermes-sweeper review. The reported stale Nous-model picker and model-switch behavior are implemented on current `main`.

- `hermes_cli/models.py:2322-2338` now sources Nous models from the authenticated live endpoint and falls back to a remotely maintained manifest, rather than an in-repo Nous snapshot.
- `hermes_cli/runtime_provider.py:1804-1815` resolves a Qwen OAuth provider switch with Qwen credentials and endpoint.
- `agent/error_classifier.py:122-124` and `:1279-1283` recognize the reported free-tier rejection as non-retryable billing instead of retrying it.
- Commit `3a9bc9d88a847feb97f86e5cde6588503871e3b8` (`fix(model picker): unify /model and hermes model lists, add disk cache`, 2026-05-28) shipped the live/manifest Nous picker path and is present in current HEAD.

No follow-up discussion was posted on the issue.
